description.value: The dominant language of the Castinellan Provinces[(PG/CG)]. This language is also used for most of Etharis's religious texts. It was until recently considered a crime to translate the teachings of the Seraphs into a language other than Castinellan. Castinellan is also predominantly spoken in Morencia[(PG/CG)], making it the most common language used in trade.
The dominant language of the Charneault Kingdom[(PG/CG)].

The highborn dialect in the Büräch Empire[(PG/CG)]. Most formal writings are in this dialect as well, such as religious texts, laws, royal decrees, plays and poems, etc. If a foreigner learns Büräch, this is the dialect they learn.
The commoner's dialect in the Büräch Empire[(PG/CG)]. It is more heavily accented than High Büräch, making the general population of the nation harder for foreigners to understand.
The dominant language of the Valikan Clans[(PG/CG)]. Each of the clans speaks a slightly different dialect of Valiki, but each dialect is similar enough to make themselves understood.
